{{Quote|Piled high with two patties, triple cheese, deep-fried Tapani triangles, mega-leaf lettuce, a slice of algae-bread, Boontaspiced mustard [&hellip;] it's just the thing to satisfy a Herglic-sized hunger.|Dex's Diner menu description for the Giju slider|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
'''Boontaspiced mustard''' was a type of [[Mustard/Legends|mustard]] flavored with [[Boontaspice/Legends|Boontaspice]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> It was edible to members of the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Besalisk" /> Boontaspiced mustard shared its name<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> with [[Boonta/Legends|Boonta]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE-Boonta">{{CSWECite|I|85|Boonta}}</ref> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] located near [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], served Boontaspiced mustard<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> The eatery's proprietor, a Besalisk [[Chef/Legends|chef]] named [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], used Boontaspiced mustard in two dishes on his menu, the [[Giju slider]] and the [[gartro egg salad sandwich]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Boontaspiced mustard was created for the [[2009]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] article "[[Dining at Dex's]]," written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu.<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
